name: Humberto Vélez
bio: Francisco Humberto Vélez Montiel (Orizaba, Veracruz de Ignacio de la Llave, March 30, 1955) is a Mexican dubbing, theater, radio and television actor with more than 35 years of experience, mainly recognized throughout Latin America for being the voice of Homer Simpson, in the popular animated series The Simpsons, a role he held from 1990 to 2004, recovering it in 2021 after 17 years.
